# Text that deliberately appears in more than one document, as "<docA> <docB> <fingerprint>".
#
# check-docs-drift.py fails on any duplication NOT listed here. Adding a line is a decision: it says
# these two documents may both carry this text, and that whoever changes one will change the other.
# Removing a line is always safe -- the check simply starts reporting the pair again.
#
# Five entries. Two are warnings that have to be readable without following a link; the rest are the
# commands a checklist cannot omit. None of them is a copy that could quietly stop matching
# the machine, which is the class this gate exists to prevent.
#
# A fourth was recorded here briefly -- the sentence describing what sensorless homing is, verbatim in
# both README and MANUAL -- and then removed by giving it one owner instead. That is the better answer
# whenever it is available: the README says what the feature is, the manual says what to do about it.

# The hardware-specific warning: MKS board, RK3328, F407 + MKS_THR F103, AP6212 WiFi. Someone must
# not get three steps in before learning this is not a generic Klipper kit, on either document.
README.md MANUAL.md 5a9768d30ce2

# The warranty warning. Same reason: it belongs on the page people land on and on the document they
# install from. If it changes it changes in both, and this gate is what tells whoever forgets.
README.md MANUAL.md 9d794c02bac0

# The by-hand rescue command. It used to sit in both documents; since the installer collects those
# files itself, only the MANUAL carries it (Appendix A0) and QUICKSTART points there. Kept on record
# because the pair returns the moment anyone puts the command back into the checklist.
MANUAL.md QUICKSTART.md 900a2f259cbf

# The one command that starts the flash. QUICKSTART exists to be the short path through the same
# procedure, and a checklist that omits the command it is a checklist for is not one. If the command
# changes it changes in both -- which is exactly what this gate is for.
MANUAL.md QUICKSTART.md 181eb3010073

# What that command then does: unpack from the stick and offer to start the flasher. It is the sentence
# that tells the reader the two-command route is gone, so both documents carry it or neither does.
MANUAL.md QUICKSTART.md 14abd2abdacb
